payload.text: hv 5 Nov, for the whole fleet (relayed by pipeliner-sc: first-hand to sc at 12:02Z, confirmed at 13:11Z): one layer of proof. A thing is proved by running it once as its user would. The commit gate's critic is the only critic. No suite that tests a suite, no planted fault beyond a guard's own one red case where it already exists, no check of a check, no hardening against setups nobody here has, no replay of a replay. A verdict is a read and at most one run. hv, on seeing checks stacked on checks: stop, it is wasting days.
